title: The History of the Crow's Nest — A Lookout Above the Fleet
description: An introduction to how sailors watched the horizon and why the lookout became a symbol of vigilance.
sources: Replace with reviewed source links for a publishable episode

scenes.heading: Eyes on the horizon
scenes.narration: Long before radar screens and satellites, keeping watch at sea depended on human eyes. A lookout high above the deck could spot changes on the horizon before anyone below.

scenes.heading: The watch never ends
scenes.narration: Across generations, sailors stood watch in wind and darkness, looking for land, weather, nearby vessels, and signs of danger. Their responsibility was simple: see what others could not.

scenes.heading: The Crow's Nest
scenes.narration: That spirit inspires The Crow's Nest. We tell the stories behind military history, the traditions that endure, and the people who carried them forward. Independent, unofficial, and always curious.
